briefdescription.para: Run distributed ingestion and return an aggregated report.

detaileddescription.para: Ingest All.

Steps:
Acquire (or renew) the leader lease — returns an empty report if this node cannot become leader within the configured TTL.
Partition sources across worker nodes via partitionSources().
Dispatch each partition to the owning node concurrently.
Aggregate partial reports and return the combined result.

briefdescription.para: Distributed ingestion coordinator using work-stealing across nodes.

detaileddescription.para:
The coordinator acts as the leader in a group of worker nodes:
It acquires a TTL-based leader lease to prevent split-brain.
It partitions a set of SourceConfig objects across worker nodes using a consistent hash ring keyed on source_id.
It dispatches each partition to the owning node concurrently (work-stealing: idle nodes may pick up tasks from busy nodes).
It aggregates the partial IngestionReport results into one report.
